description: Audit the Project panel against explicit layout rules (allowed root names, extension-to-bin placement, a sequences bin, maximum bin depth, empty bins) and report violations by node ID. Read-only by default (inspect authority): walks up to 5000 items, reports truncation, and returns at most 200 proposed moves plus a plan_token bound to the project, rules, and those exact moves. With apply: true (edit authority) it requires that plan_token, re-reads the project and refuses if the plan changed, the walk was truncated, or any target path is ambiguous (two bins with one name at a level). It then creates missing target bins and moves only the planned items, reading back each item's parent bin; outcome is verified only when every move is verified, otherwise partial or failed with per-item details. It never deletes, renames, or moves bins; root-name, depth, and empty-bin findings are report-only.

apply.description: false (default) audits without changing Premiere. true creates missing target bins and moves the planned items; requires plan_token and the edit capability.

expected_cep_target.description: Optional reviewed CEP sequence/clip identity and exact tick ranges. Checked before every generated command; UXP refuses this CEP-only guard.

effect.description: Reviewed effect and parameter identity checked before mutation.

match_name.description: Effect match name from host inspection.

end_ticks.description: Exact expected exclusive timeline end ticks.

out_ticks.description: Exact expected exclusive source Out ticks.

track_index.description: Expected zero-based track index; identity still checked.

project_document_id.description: Exact Premiere project document ID observed during review.

source_item.description: Reviewed source identity for a source-only operation.

expected_project_path.description: Optional absolute saved-project path. Every generated CEP command refuses before its body when the active project differs or is unsaved. UXP commands refuse this CEP-only guard; local-only tools do not inspect Premiere. Omit to keep existing behavior.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-chosen key (1-128 chars of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -) for this intended edit. Pass a fresh key per edit and reuse it only when retrying that same edit, for example after a client-side timeout. A repeat with the same tool, key and arguments is not run again: while the first call is running it fails with IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS (poll get_last_operations); after it finished it returns the original outcome marked replayed. A definite failure with nothing applied (receipt outcome not_applied) may be retried with the same key. Reusing a key with different arguments fails with IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. Scoped to this MCP session (the stdio server process or one HTTP session) and held in memory only (200 keys, 1 hour); it does not survive a restart or reconnect. Read-only invocations are never deduplicated.

plan_token.description: Required when apply is true: the planToken returned by the audit with the same rules. Apply refuses if the project's current plan no longer matches it.

rules.description: Layout rules; at least one must be set. Unknown keys are rejected.

allowed_root_names.description: Names allowed directly in the project root. Exact, case-sensitive names or simple globs where * matches any characters and ? matches one. Other root items are reported (not moved unless another rule moves them).

extension_bins.description: Map of media extension (".wav", case-insensitive, dot plus 1-16 letters or digits) to a slash-separated bin path from the root, e.g. {".wav":"Audio/SFX", ".mp4":"Footage"}. Clips whose media extension matches and that are not already inside that bin (or a bin nested in it) get a proposed move. Up to 100 extensions, 16 path segments.

forbid_empty_bins.description: Report bins with no children. Report-only: this tool never deletes bins.

max_depth.description: Maximum bin nesting depth (a bin in the root is depth 1). Deeper bins are reported only. Target paths deeper than this are rejected.

sequences_bin.description: Slash-separated bin path for sequences, e.g. "Sequences" or "Edit/Sequences". Sequences outside it (or bins nested in it) get a proposed move.

name: audit_project_structure

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true; on failure, diagnostic detail when the tool provides it.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

idempotency.description: Present when idempotency_key deduplicated this call: replayed is true when the original outcome was returned instead of running again.

receipt.description: Versioned common mutation receipt; success never implies rendered verification.
